meta.title: Rostislav Volkov — websites and Android apps, built end to end
meta.description: Full-stack developer: Nuxt 3 and Laravel websites, Flutter mobile apps. From idea and backend to publishing on RuStore and Google Play.

seo.personJobTitle: Full-stack developer and indie mobile app developer

hero.title: Websites and Android apps, built end to end and shipped to the stores
hero.subtitle: Laravel on the backend, Nuxt 3 and Next.js on the front end, Flutter for mobile — I take a product from idea and architecture through to release. I set up the servers myself and publish finished apps on RuStore and Google Play.
hero.stat2Label: sites and apps from one developer

stack.title: Stack
stack.subtitle: The tools I build products with every day — from the backend to a store release.

work.title: Work
work.subtitle: Web services and Android apps I designed, built, and shipped.

my-financier-web.name: My Financier
my-financier-web.description: A personal finance web app: Nuxt 3 on the front end (SSR), a Laravel API, PostgreSQL and Redis underneath. It ships alongside a companion Android app, with data synced between web and mobile.
my-financier-web.note: Paired with a native Android app — My Financier for mobile.
highlights: Nuxt 3 SSR front end, Laravel API backend
Tuned nginx: keepalive pools to upstream, WebSocket support, SSL session cache

my-financier-app.name: My Financier
my-financier-app.description: A native Flutter companion to my-financier.ru, built offline-first — data lives locally and syncs back to the web account.
my-financier-app.note: Works together with the my-financier.ru web service.

glidespark.name: GlideSpark (Парящая искра)
glidespark.description: A neon, one-tap space arcade. Instead of just a leaderboard, you race against 'ghosts' — recorded runs from other players on a track generated from a shared seed, so everyone gets the exact same layout.
highlights: Ghost duels against other players' recorded runs
Seeded generation — you and the ghost race the same track
Global leaderboard and friend challenges; coins are cosmetic-only

sudoku.name: Sudoku
sudoku.description: Classic sudoku with several difficulty levels and a fully offline mode.
sudoku.note: The only project in this portfolio published on both RuStore and Google Play.
highlights: Published on both RuStore and Google Play

merge-city.name: Merge City (Слияние городов)
merge-city.description: A merge game on a 5×5 board with 9 progression levels and themed item sets.

riddles-puzzles.name: Riddles & Puzzles (Загадки и головоломки)
riddles-puzzles.description: A content-heavy app: hundreds of riddles across categories, rebus puzzles, daily challenges, and an achievement system.
highlights: Hundreds of riddles across categories plus 90 rebus puzzles

process.title: How I work
process.subtitle: Four steps from idea to a product you can maintain and grow.

step1.title: Discussion and estimate
step1.description: We define the task, goals and budget, and agree on the scope and timeline for the first iteration.

step2.title: Prototype and architecture
step2.description: I design the data model and service architecture and put together a clickable interface prototype.

step3.title: Development with interim demos
step3.description: I work in short iterations and show working builds at every stage.

step4.title: Launch, support, analytics
step4.description: I set up the server and CI/CD, publish to the stores, wire up analytics, and stay on for support.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: I take on the whole build, or plug in at the stage you need.

item1.title: Website & landing pages
item1.description: Landing pages and business sites built on Nuxt: fast loading, SEO out of the box, fully responsive.

item2.title: Web service with a user dashboard
item2.description: SaaS and internal tools with auth, roles and a personal account — a Laravel API paired with a Nuxt or Next.js front end.

item3.title: Flutter app
item3.description: Android/iOS apps built with Flutter, from prototype through publishing on RuStore and Google Play.

item4.title: APIs & integrations
item4.description: Designing and building REST/WebSocket APIs, plus integrations with third-party services and payment providers.

item5.title: Server setup & release delivery
item5.description: nginx, Docker, CI/CD — I configure servers, automate deployment, and keep things stable after launch.
